description: This source file contains unit tests for the ChatMarkdownPreprocessor component in the OpenClawChatUI project, specifically testing markdown preprocessing functionalities including image handling, metadata stripping, and text cleaning.

classes.name: ChatMarkdownPreprocessorTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple unit tests for the ChatMarkdownPreprocessor.

methods.name: extractsDataURLImages
methods.description: Tests extraction and handling of base64-encoded images in markdown.

methods.name: flattensRemoteMarkdownImagesIntoText
methods.description: Tests handling of remote images and conversion to text labels.

methods.name: usesFallbackTextForUnlabeledRemoteMarkdownImages
methods.description: Ensures fallback text is used when markdown images lack alt text.

methods.name: handlesUnicodeBeforeRemoteMarkdownImages
methods.description: Tests handling of unicode characters preceding markdown images.

methods.name: stripsInboundUntrustedContextBlocks
methods.description: Verifies removal of inbound untrusted metadata blocks from markdown.

methods.name: stripsSingleConversationInfoBlock
methods.description: Ensures singleton conversation info blocks are stripped from markdown.

methods.name: stripsAllKnownInboundMetadataSentinels
methods.description: Checks that various known metadata sentinel lines are removed appropriately.

methods.name: preservesNonMetadataJsonFence
methods.description: Ensures JSON code fences not marked as metadata are preserved.

methods.name: stripsEnvelopeHeadersAndMessageIdHints
methods.description: Removes envelope headers and message ID hints from markdown content.

methods.name: stripsTrailingUntrustedContextSuffix
methods.description: Removes untrusted context suffixes from markdown messages.

methods.name: preservesUntrustedContextHeaderWhenItIsUserContent
methods.description: Ensures that untrusted context headers are preserved if they contain user content.
